# Occupancy

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Occupancy`](gmeow-Occupancy.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Occupancy>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A measurement of the current number of entities located at or within a location. The location is the [`observedFeature`](../properties/gmeow-observedFeature.md); the result is a [`ScalarQuantity`](gmeow-ScalarQuantity.md). Typically computed by the solver layer from [`locatedAt`](../properties/gmeow-locatedAt.md) relationships and active [`LocationState`](gmeow-LocationState.md) instances (P12), but may also be asserted directly from sensor readings or manual counts.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Measurement`](gmeow-Measurement.md)

Use [`gmeow:Occupancy`](gmeow-Occupancy.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Measurement`](gmeow-Measurement.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to reify the current number of entities at a location, as a [`Measurement`](gmeow-Measurement.md) (sensor reading, manual count, or solver-derived).

### Avoid when

- Avoid asserting it where the solver should derive it from [`locatedAt`](../properties/gmeow-locatedAt.md) / active LocationStates (P12) unless you have a direct count.

### How to use

- Mint [`Occupancy`](gmeow-Occupancy.md), set [`gmeow:occupancyOf`](../properties/gmeow-occupancyOf.md), and point [`gmeow:observationResult`](../properties/gmeow-observationResult.md) at a [`ScalarQuantity`](gmeow-ScalarQuantity.md); pair with [`Capacity`](gmeow-Capacity.md) to derive [`Utilization`](gmeow-Utilization.md).

### Examples

- ex:occ a [`gmeow:Occupancy`](gmeow-Occupancy.md); [`gmeow:occupancyOf`](../properties/gmeow-occupancyOf.md) ex:hall; [`gmeow:observationResult`](../properties/gmeow-observationResult.md) ex:scalar120.
